name: Car Pal - MOT, Tax & Car Check

ios.desc:
Check any UK vehicle in seconds. Type a reg plate and Car Pal pulls the official DVLA and DVSA records - tax status, MOT status, full test history and more into one clean, fast app.

THE FULL PICTURE, ONE SEARCH

Tax and MOT status with due dates, colour-coded so problems jump out
Full MOT history - every test, advisory, defect and failure
Mileage history with a chart, plus automatic warnings when a reading goes backwards (possible clocking)
ULEZ compliance and estimated road tax costs
Outstanding manufacturer safety recall alerts
Make, model, colour, engine size, CO2, V5C issue date and more

YOUR GARAGE

Save the cars you own (or are about to buy) and see their status at a glance. Pull to refresh for the latest DVLA data - Car Pal also refreshes automatically when your saved data gets stale.

NEVER MISS A RENEWAL
Set tax and MOT reminders and get notified 30 days, 14 days and 1 day before they're due. No more fines for a lapsed MOT you forgot about.

BUYING A USED CAR?
Check it before you view it. MOT failures, dodgy mileage, outstanding recalls and SORN status are all in the history - two minutes with Car Pal can save you thousands.

CAR PAL PRO
Upgrade to remove all ads and unlock full MOT history, mileage analysis, tax & MOT reminders, unlimited checks and unlimited saved cars. 

Data direct from official DVLA and DVSA sources.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I leant Swift and built a car MOT / Tax Lookup with data from DVSA

quotes.text:
I've been diving into Swift during my evenings and weekends. As a full stack developer with 20+ years of experience, mostly in PHP, JS, and HTML, this is my first venture into something new.

I've built a fun app that uses DVLA/DVSA open data to query vehicle registrations and lets you set reminders. It's been a great way for me to learn and challenge myself.

I'd love to hear any feedback!
